_README: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA. Not an FL511 recording.
Every other file in this directory was captured verbatim from fl511.com on 2026-11-16. This
one was written by hand, because at capture time FL511 had ZERO events of any kind inside the
PortMiami study area (statewide: 2 incidents, 23 closures, 113 construction, 0 congestion, 10
disabled vehicles - none of them in the box). Rendering, filtering and road association could
not be exercised against a real in-area event, so these were constructed.
What IS real about them: the coordinates. Each sits on the midpoint of a named PortMiami
centreline in public/data/portmiami_roads_merged.geojson, so the association tests run against
genuine county geometry. The envelope is the real one FL511 uses (item2 / itemId / location as
This file is used ONLY by tests/liveTraffic.test.mjs. It is never served to the application
